name: d3_ckpt
_comment: Follow-up to d3.json (plan §9 2026-09-30): there, clear_logged ~= ops -- every buffered
record was materialised into its leaf ALONE, because SQLite's default auto-checkpoint
(1000 frames) flushes ~1000 random records onto ~1000 of ~120k leaves.  The question this
answers: do D3a/D3b pay once records live long enough to share a leaf?
Axis: wal_autocheckpoint 1000 (default) / 10000 / 0 (never during the run).  Read
ops / clear_logged (records per flushed leaf) beside ops/s, read B/op and write B/op.
Durable mode only (group 1); stock runs on the same axis as the reference.
